# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c25 P46](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P59](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0059), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome young lady with a plump, showy figure, large bright-blue eyes, and a brilliant complexion. She has long, thick golden hair, which she wore in a yellow braid as a young girl and later did up while in town. She wears her skirts as long as her mother permits and dresses stylishly.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and frankly enjoys the pleasant things in life. She is quite emotional and prone to hysterical tears during alarming or dramatic situations. Sentimental by nature, she is pre-occupied with romance, suitors, and male attention. She laughs a great deal and is delighted by compliments and social excitement.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Goals

- To have numerous suitors and enjoy a gay youth before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- To teach for two years after completing Queen's and then get married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

As a schoolgirl in Avonlea, Ruby attended class under Mr. Phillips and frequently shared gossip about suitors and romance. She was a member of the story club created by Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, and she participated in the school concert's tableau and dialogues. Later, she joined Miss Stacy's Queen's preparation class and successfully passed the entrance exams. While attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, she lived in a boarding house and was considered the handsomest girl of her year. After graduating from Queen's with her teaching license, she obtained the position of schoolteacher at Carmody, allowing her to stay connected with her Avonlea friends.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P59](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0059), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)_
